title: Prove the exact weighted tariff for two normal semilinear targets
body:
## Summary

Prove the exact weighted tariff **2 min(a, 2b)** for two nonidentity normal targets in every odd-prime-degree binary semilinear group. Normal calls cost a>0 and outside calls cost b>0. Repeated labels, arbitrary finite restored dirty workspace and free binary scalar mixing are allowed. The claim type is a **scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration**, with no new kappa or selected-frontier change.

```text
three outside calls close their quotient character
  => their binary rank-one projectors coincide
  => the full formal endpoint cannot serve two independent normal targets
four outside calls attain the endpoint
natural-rank budget + this obstruction => exact weighted tariff
```

This answers the two-normal-target first experiment in Krzysztof Wojt's PR5242 Open next question 1. The new contribution is quotient-loop rigidity, the repeated-label case, and the weighted tariff. Josie Elliston's PR6048 already excludes three calls for distinct pair targets in every group when no paid label is a target; that distinct-target floor is credited and is not claimed as new. PR5242's natural representation is a cited premise, not an audit deliverable.

The proof, construction and verifier were produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Krzysztof Wojt / PR5242; Nick Petalas / PR5202; Cinna Davis / PR2011 and PR3893; Josie Elliston / PR6048, following PR6038; eumemic / PR288 and the retained register-model lineage. Only one isolated research package is added.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19360644). Canonical main was refreshed before commitment and remained `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8. Live claims, reservations, all 351 cached open PRs and merged/main-tree searches were checked. Coverage does not certify novelty against unpublished work or every historical diff.

## Evidence

- Before: PR5242's paired rank relaxation permits three outside calls for two normal targets at degree three. After: the new written quotient lemma excludes those words uniformly over all finite role counts and all odd prime degrees, including equal target labels. Two normal calls or four outside calls attain the exact full formal endpoint.
- Exact finite checks enumerate 32,840 factor pairs and 1,120 quotient loops over F4/F8 at one to three roles. A separate direct algorithm checks all 1,728 F4 two-role triples and its 12 loops, without the pair/inverse lookup. These finite checks corroborate the written universal proof.
- The full order-21 algebra checks 4,116 literal outside-only loop words and 144 attaining words for all 36 ordered normal-target pairs, preserving the arbitrary third dirty role coefficient by coefficient. A bounded 13,203-case count/price screen corroborates the unbounded proof's case split.
- Eleven domain/semantic rejection controls pass, together with a real nonbinary boundary counterexample. Three disposable altered-code runs reject dropped formal arithmetic, a wrong outside label and an omitted factor.
- Local CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64, standard library only: normal and optimized warning-strict direct commands pass in 0.3284s and 0.3337s; registered replay passes in 0.9028s. Normal/optimized generated receipts agree exactly. Each registered command is bounded to 60 seconds, well below the hosted limit.
- `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` validates all eight files, modes and declared source ancestry at `fcf24f98c7b86fd522638700fbf619220bdd845d`. Official export and declared-input checks pass. Both normal and optimized direct commands pass in a read-only Git-free export with empty PATH; all nine exported files retain their bytes and modes.
- Warning-strict source compilation, function bounds and staged whitespace pass. A local Python linter/type checker is unavailable and unrun. No predecessor scientific census was replayed.

Reproduce from the repository root with the exact local interpreter path below, or another CPython 3.12 installation:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/semilinear-two-normal-prices/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -O -W error -B research/semilinear-two-normal-prices/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/semilinear-two-normal-prices
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/semilinear-two-normal-prices --check-source-history --check-modes
```

The direct verifier prints `PASS_SEMILINEAR_TWO_NORMAL_PRICES` in a fresh JSON receipt bound to every package file. It writes no files and reads no external mathematical runtime inputs. Provenance pins authenticate the credited source statements separately.

## Limitations

This is a formal type-price theorem. Native realization, physical ownership/restoration, routing, frames, precision, stock/compiler and a complete supplier/recursive/outer bill remain unknown. The theorem does not cover three or more normal targets, mixed targets, arbitrary per-label prices, nonbinary mixing or higher-rank paid calls. No complete multiplication theorem, physical supplier, admission or frontier update is claimed.

Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Lean, Docker and the selected scientific cold replay were not run. The universal quantifiers rest on the written proof, not finite extrapolation or hosted CI.

## Open next questions

- Can three normal targets share outside calls with unequal type prices? Start with one outside-only count admitted by the natural-rank inequality, then derive or refute its full formal endpoint. A longer-word structure theorem or explicit sharing word is missing.
- Can an actual native caller realize two outside maps below the complete price of one normal map? Bind one source/consumer boundary and charge role changes, movement and restoration. The source-bound native interface is missing.

## Related open work

The completion refresh listed ten other open PRs from this account created since the advance CLAIM at 2026-11-02T21:10:19Z. None computes this semilinear weighted two-normal tariff. Adjacent scopes are distinguished below; no additional computations were run to compare other results.

- [PR6393](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6393) studies a weighted multilinear Boolean dirty-input query tariff. Its operation alphabet and endpoint differ; no shared numerical tariff is computed here.
- [PR6408](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6408) proves vector-cocycle call floors for formal rank-one register words with broader complement actions. It computes no weighted two-normal semilinear tariff; the invariant and target family differ.
- [PR6410](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6410) proves weighted central UT4 letter tariffs in a formal dirty-register model. The group, alphabet and target differ; no common numerical tariff is computed here.

Merged PR5242 poses this question. Merged PR6048 covers the distinct-target short-word floor and is credited above; neither predecessor is re-audited.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks passed at exact head `fcf24f98c7b86fd522638700fbf619220bdd845d` in [run 41527208284](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41527208284): [plan](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41527208284/job/125557908514) in 4m33s and [replay (research/semilinear-two-normal-prices)](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41527208284/job/125560288242) in 1m20s. The completed checks were read once; separate run metadata confirms completed success and the matching head.

Hosted replay exercises the registered normal/optimized finite checks and source metadata. It does not establish independent acceptance of the universal written proof or discharge native, physical, supplier or all-size obligations. All recorded local checks, committed-byte/source-history/mode checks and read-only Git-free export checks also passed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review remain unclaimed.

## Merge Danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. Eight new files in one opt-in research package. Shared code, frozen sources and selected-frontier records are unchanged.
